description: This file contains the code-behind for the LoginPage of an online examination system. It manages user login operations for students and teachers, including database verification for students and hardcoded credential checking for teachers.

classes.name: LoginPage
classes.description: Partial class representing the login page logic for the online examination system, handling user authentication.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the initial page load event. Currently, no logic is implemented here.

methods.name: signupB
methods.description: Handles the event when the sign-up button is clicked, redirecting users to the sign-up page.

methods.name: loginButton_Click
methods.description: Handles the login button click event, performing credential validation for students via database lookup or teachers via hardcoded check, and redirects accordingly.
